import Mathlib

structure BFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BFSGraph.well_formed (g : BFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.size (g : BFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BFSGraph.has_edge (g : BFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BFSGraph.is_path (g : BFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def BFSGraph.reachable (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

def BFSGraph.is_shortest_distance (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (d : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target ∧ p.length = d + 1) ∧
  (∀ p, g.is_path p → p.head? = some start → p.getLast? = some target → p.length ≥ d + 1)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_precond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ graph.size ≤ 10000 ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

/-- Neighbour set of `u`, as a `Finset`, guarded by the size condition so that
membership is exactly `has_edge`. -/
def BFSGraph.nbrsF (g : BFSGraph) (u : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  if u < g.adj.size then (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.toFinset else ∅

/-- `ball start k` is the set of nodes reachable from `start` using at most `k` edges. -/
def BFSGraph.ball (g : BFSGraph) (start : Nat) (k : Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Finset Nat) ({start} : Finset Nat)
    (fun _ S => S ∪ S.biUnion (fun u => g.nbrsF u)) k

/-- Finds the least `j ≤ k` with `target ∈ ball start j`, if any. -/
def BFSGraph.search (g : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (k : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Option Nat)
    (if target ∈ g.ball start 0 then some 0 else none)
    (fun j prev =>
      match prev with
      | some d => some d
      | none => if target ∈ g.ball start (j + 1) then some (j + 1) else none) k

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def bfs_shortest_path (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  graph.search start target graph.adj.size
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def bfs_shortest_path_postcond (graph : BFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : bfs_shortest_path_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some dist => graph.is_shortest_distance start target dist
  | none => ¬ graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### Basic `getD` lemmas -/

theorem gd_cons_zero (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).getD 0 0 = a := by
  simp [List.getD]

theorem gd_cons_succ (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (a :: l).getD (i + 1) 0 = l.getD i 0 := by
  simp [List.getD]

theorem gd_append_left (l1 l2 : List Nat) (i : Nat) (h : i < l1.length) :
    (l1 ++ l2).getD i 0 = l1.getD i 0 := by
  induction l1 generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases i with
    | zero => rw [List.cons_append, gd_cons_zero, gd_cons_zero]
    | succ j =>
      rw [List.cons_append, gd_cons_succ, gd_cons_succ]
      exact ih j (by simpa using h)

theorem gd_append_len (l1 : List Nat) (v : Nat) : (l1 ++ [v]).getD l1.length 0 = v := by
  induction l1 with
  | nil => simpa using gd_cons_zero v []
  | cons a t ih =>
    have hl : (a :: t).length = t.length + 1 := by simp
    rw [hl, List.cons_append, gd_cons_succ]
    exact ih

theorem gd_head {p : List Nat} {a : Nat} (h : p.head? = some a) : p.getD 0 0 = a := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b t =>
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at h
    rw [gd_cons_zero, h]

/-! ### `getLast?` characterisation -/

theorem getLast?_eq_append {p : List Nat} {a : Nat} (h : p.getLast? = some a) :
    ∃ q, p = q ++ [a] := by
  induction p using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp at h
  | append_singleton q b _ =>
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    have hb : b = a := by simpa using h
    rw [hb]

theorem gd_last {p : List Nat} {a : Nat} (h : p.getLast? = some a) :
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = a := by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := getLast?_eq_append h
  have hlen : (q ++ [a]).length - 1 = q.length := by simp
  rw [hlen, gd_append_len]

/-! ### `ball` equations and basic properties -/

theorem BFSGraph.ball_zero (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) : g.ball s 0 = {s} := rfl

theorem BFSGraph.ball_succ (g : BFSGraph) (s k : Nat) :
    g.ball s (k + 1) = g.ball s k ∪ (g.ball s k).biUnion (fun u => g.nbrsF u) := rfl

theorem mem_nbrsF {g : BFSGraph} {u v : Nat} : v ∈ g.nbrsF u ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  unfold BFSGraph.nbrsF BFSGraph.has_edge
  by_cases h : u < g.adj.size
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

theorem ball_mono_succ (g : BFSGraph) (s k : Nat) : g.ball s k ⊆ g.ball s (k + 1) := by
  rw [BFSGraph.ball_succ]
  exact Finset.subset_union_left

theorem ball_mono (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) :
    ∀ k m : Nat, k ≤ m → g.ball s k ⊆ g.ball s m := by
  intro k m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    intro h
    have hk : k = 0 := by omega
    subst hk
    exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ m ih =>
    intro h
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m + 1) with h1 | h1
    · exact (ih (by omega)).trans (ball_mono_succ g s m)
    · have hk : k = m + 1 := by omega
      subst hk
      exact Finset.Subset.refl _

theorem ball_stable (g : BFSGraph) (s k : Nat) (h : g.ball s (k + 1) = g.ball s k) :
    ∀ m, g.ball s (k + m) = g.ball s k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    have e : k + (m + 1) = (k + m) + 1 := by omega
    rw [e, BFSGraph.ball_succ, ih, ← BFSGraph.ball_succ, h]

theorem ball_bound (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) (hwf : g.well_formed) (hs : s < g.adj.size) :
    ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ g.ball s k, x < g.adj.size := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro x hx
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_zero] at hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    subst hx
    exact hs
  | succ k ih =>
    intro x hx
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_succ] at hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with h | h
    · exact ih x h
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, hxu⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h
      have he := mem_nbrsF.mp hxu
      exact hwf u he.1 x he.2

theorem ball_card_ge (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) :
    ∀ k, (∀ j, j < k → g.ball s (j + 1) ≠ g.ball s j) → k + 1 ≤ (g.ball s k).card := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_zero]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro hne
    have h1 := ih (fun j hj => hne j (by omega))
    have h2 : g.ball s k ⊆ g.ball s (k + 1) := ball_mono_succ g s k
    have h3 : g.ball s k ≠ g.ball s (k + 1) := by
      intro hh
      exact hne k (by omega) hh.symm
    have h4 : (g.ball s k).card < (g.ball s (k + 1)).card :=
      Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨h2, h3⟩)
    omega

theorem ball_eventually (g : BFSGraph) (s n : Nat)
    (hb : ∀ k, ∀ x ∈ g.ball s k, x < n) :
    ∀ m, n ≤ m → g.ball s m = g.ball s n := by
  by_cases hall : ∀ j, j < n → g.ball s (j + 1) ≠ g.ball s j
  · exfalso
    have hc1 := ball_card_ge g s n hall
    have hsub : g.ball s n ⊆ Finset.range n := by
      intro x hx
      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hb n x hx)
    have hc2 := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Finset.card_range] at hc2
    omega
  · push_neg at hall
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hje⟩ := hall
    intro m hm
    have e1 := ball_stable g s j hje (n - j)
    have e2 := ball_stable g s j hje (m - j)
    have q1 : j + (n - j) = n := by omega
    have q2 : j + (m - j) = m := by omega
    rw [q1] at e1
    rw [q2] at e2
    rw [e1, e2]

/-! ### Soundness / completeness of `ball` -/

theorem ball_sound (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) :
    ∀ (k v : Nat), v ∈ g.ball s k →
      ∃ p : List Nat, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some s ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧
        p.length ≤ k + 1 := by

  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro v hv
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_zero] at hv
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    subst hv
    refine ⟨[v], ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro i hi
      exact absurd hi (by simp)
    · simp
    · simp
    · simp
  | succ k ih =>
    intro v hv
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_succ] at hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with h | h
    · obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hlen⟩ := ih v h
      exact ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, by omega⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp h
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hlen⟩ := ih u hu

      have hedge : g.has_edge u v := mem_nbrsF.mp hvu

      · simp
      · intro i hi
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hi
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) p.length with h1 | h1
        · rw [gd_append_left p [v] i (by omega), gd_append_left p [v] (i + 1) h1]
          exact hp.2 i h1
        · have hip : i + 1 = p.length := by omega
          have e1 : p.getD i 0 = u := by
            rw [← hu_eq]
            congr 1
            omega
          rw [gd_append_left p [v] i (by omega), e1, hip, gd_append_len p v]
          exact hedge
      · cases p with
        | nil => simp at hpl
        | cons a t => simpa using hh
      · simp
      · simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
        omega

theorem path_mem_ball (g : BFSGraph) (s : Nat) (p : List Nat)
    (hp : g.is_path p) (hh : p.head? = some s) :
    ∀ i, i < p.length → p.getD i 0 ∈ g.ball s i := by

  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro _
    have h0 : p.getD 0 0 = s := gd_head hh
    rw [h0, BFSGraph.ball_zero]
    simp
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    have hi' : i < p.length := by omega
    have h1 := ih hi'
    have h2 := hp.2 i hi
    rw [BFSGraph.ball_succ]

/-! ### `search` equations and correctness -/

theorem BFSGraph.search_zero (g : BFSGraph) (s t : Nat) :
    g.search s t 0 = if t ∈ g.ball s 0 then some 0 else none := rfl

theorem search_succ_some (g : BFSGraph) (s t k d : Nat) (h : g.search s t k = some d) :
    g.search s t (k + 1) = some d := by
  show (match g.search s t k with
        | some d => some d
        | none => if t ∈ g.ball s (k + 1) then some (k + 1) else none) = some d
  rw [h]

theorem search_succ_none (g : BFSGraph) (s t k : Nat) (h : g.search s t k = none) :
    g.search s t (k + 1) = if t ∈ g.ball s (k + 1) then some (k + 1) else none := by
  show (match g.search s t k with
        | some d => some d
        | none => if t ∈ g.ball s (k + 1) then some (k + 1) else none) = _
  rw [h]

theorem search_none_spec (g : BFSGraph) (s t : Nat) :
    ∀ k, g.search s t k = none → ∀ j, j ≤ k → t ∉ g.ball s j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro h j hj
    have hj0 : j = 0 := by omega
    subst hj0
    rw [BFSGraph.search_zero] at h
    by_cases hb : t ∈ g.ball s 0
    · rw [if_pos hb] at h
      simp at h
    · exact hb
  | succ k ih =>
    intro h j hj
    cases hk : g.search s t k with
    | some d =>
      rw [search_succ_some g s t k d hk] at h
      simp at h
    | none =>
      rw [search_succ_none g s t k hk] at h
      by_cases hb : t ∈ g.ball s (k + 1)
      · rw [if_pos hb] at h
        simp at h
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (k + 1) with h1 | h1
        · exact ih hk j (by omega)
        · have hje : j = k + 1 := by omega
          subst hje
          exact hb

theorem search_some_spec (g : BFSGraph) (s t : Nat) :
    ∀ k d, g.search s t k = some d → t ∈ g.ball s d ∧ ∀ j, j < d → t ∉ g.ball s j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro d h
    rw [BFSGraph.search_zero] at h
    by_cases hb : t ∈ g.ball s 0
    · rw [if_pos hb] at h
      have hd : 0 = d := by simpa using h
      subst hd
      refine ⟨hb, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hb] at h
      simp at h
  | succ k ih =>
    intro d h
    cases hk : g.search s t k with
    | some d' =>
      rw [search_succ_some g s t k d' hk] at h
      have hd : d' = d := by simpa using h
      subst hd
      exact ih d' hk
    | none =>
      rw [search_succ_none g s t k hk] at h
      by_cases hb : t ∈ g.ball s (k + 1)
      · rw [if_pos hb] at h
        have hd : k + 1 = d := by simpa using h
        subst hd
        refine ⟨hb, ?_⟩
        intro j hj
        exact search_none_spec g s t k hk j (by omega)
      · rw [if_neg hb] at h
        simp at h
